 Payton Pritchard leads team in scoring Monday 
 by Leo Sells | Celtics Correspondent | Mon, Oct 26th 2026, 11:06pm EDT 
 Payton Pritchard dropped 28 points (10-16 FG, 7-10 3PT, 1-1 FT) and logged two steals in Monday's 134-99 win over the Chicago Bulls. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Pritchard came off of the bench on Monday, but he was fantastic through just 22 minutes of action. He led the team with 28 points scored on the night, and he was able to do that while maintaining terrific shooting splits from the field. He will likely continue to be a boom-or-bust fantasy option on a game-to-game basis moving forward.
